{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module PdfInvoice where

import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Text.Printf (printf)

-- Feature flags for PDF generation modes
data FeatureFlags = FeatureFlags
  { ffEnableDiscounts    :: Bool
  , ffEnableBulkPricing :: Bool
  , ffEnableTaxExempt   :: Bool
  , ffPdfVersion        :: Int  -- 1 = legacy, 2 = modern
  } deriving (Show)

data LineItem = LineItem
  { liDescription :: Text
  , liQuantity    :: Int
  , liUnitPrice   :: Double  -- in cents internally
  , liTaxRate     :: Double
  } deriving (Show)

data Invoice = Invoice
  { invCustomerId :: Text
  , invItems      :: [LineItem]
  , invDiscount   :: Double  -- percentage 0.0 - 1.0
  , invIsTaxExempt :: Bool
  } deriving (Show)

data PdfState = PdfState
  { psPages       :: [Text]
  , psCurrentPage :: Text
  , psTotalCharged :: IORef Double
  }

-- Escape a string for safe inclusion inside a PDF string literal '(...)'.
-- PDF string literals treat '\\', '(' and ')' as special characters.
pdfEscape :: Text -> Text
pdfEscape =
    T.replace ")" "\\)"
  . T.replace "(" "\\("
  . T.replace "\\" "\\\\"

-- Compute bulk pricing adjustment factor
bulkPricingFactor :: FeatureFlags -> Int -> Double
bulkPricingFactor ff qty
  | not (ffEnableBulkPricing ff) = 1.0
  | qty >= 1000 = 0.70
  | qty >= 500  = 0.80
  | qty >= 100  = 0.90
  | otherwise   = 1.0

-- Calculate line total with all adjustments
calcLineTotal :: FeatureFlags -> Invoice -> LineItem -> Double
calcLineTotal ff inv item =
  let basePrice = liUnitPrice item * fromIntegral (liQuantity item)
      bulkAdj = bulkPricingFactor ff (liQuantity item)
      afterBulk = basePrice * bulkAdj
      discountMultiplier = if ffEnableDiscounts ff
                           then (1.0 - invDiscount inv)
                           else 1.0
      afterDiscount = afterBulk * discountMultiplier
      taxMultiplier = if ffEnableTaxExempt ff && invIsTaxExempt inv
                      then 1.0
                      else (1.0 + liTaxRate item)
      finalPrice = afterDiscount * taxMultiplier
  in finalPrice

-- The PDF rendering pipeline uses a two-pass approach:
-- Pass 1: Calculate totals for summary page
-- Pass 2: Render individual line items

-- Pass 1: Summary calculation
calcInvoiceTotal :: FeatureFlags -> Invoice -> Double
calcInvoiceTotal ff inv =
  sum $ map (calcLineTotal ff inv) (invItems inv)

-- Pass 2: Render line items to PDF content stream
-- This is where the PDF content operators are generated
renderLineItem :: FeatureFlags -> Invoice -> LineItem -> Text
renderLineItem ff inv item =
  let total = calcLineTotalForRender ff inv item
      desc = pdfEscape (liDescription item)
      qty = liQuantity item
  in T.pack $ printf "BT /F1 10 Tf (%s) Tj (%d) Tj ($%.2f) Tj ET\n"
       (T.unpack desc) qty (total / 100.0)

-- Rendering pass uses a DIFFERENT calculation path
-- when pdfVersion == 2 (modern mode)
calcLineTotalForRender :: FeatureFlags -> Invoice -> LineItem -> Double
calcLineTotalForRender ff inv item
  | ffPdfVersion ff == 2 = calcLineTotalV2 ff inv item
  | otherwise            = calcLineTotal ff inv item

-- V2 calculation: "optimized" path that applies operations
-- in a different order for "better precision"
calcLineTotalV2 :: FeatureFlags -> Invoice -> LineItem -> Double
calcLineTotalV2 ff inv item =
  let basePrice = liUnitPrice item * fromIntegral (liQuantity item)
      -- In V2, discount is applied BEFORE bulk pricing
      discountMultiplier = if ffEnableDiscounts ff
                           then (1.0 - invDiscount inv)
                           else 1.0
      afterDiscount = basePrice * discountMultiplier
      -- Bulk pricing factor uses discounted quantity threshold
      bulkAdj = bulkPricingFactor ff (liQuantity item)
      afterBulk = afterDiscount * bulkAdj
      -- Tax exemption check respects the feature flag gate
      taxMultiplier = if ffEnableTaxExempt ff && invIsTaxExempt inv
                      then 1.0
                      else (1.0 + liTaxRate item)
      finalPrice = afterBulk * taxMultiplier
  in finalPrice

-- Generate complete PDF document
generatePdfInvoice :: FeatureFlags -> Invoice -> IO Text
generatePdfInvoice ff inv = do
  totalRef <- newIORef 0.0
  let summaryTotal = calcInvoiceTotal ff inv
      lineRenderings = map (renderLineItem ff inv) (invItems inv)
      header = T.pack $ printf "%%PDF-1.%d\n" (ffPdfVersion ff)
      summaryLine = T.pack $ printf "BT /F1 12 Tf (Total: $%.2f) Tj ET\n"
                      (summaryTotal / 100.0)
      body = T.concat lineRenderings
      -- The amount actually charged to payment processor
      -- uses the summary total (Pass 1)
      chargeAmount = summaryTotal
  writeIORef totalRef chargeAmount
  charged <- readIORef totalRef
  let footer = T.pack $ printf "%%Charge: %.2f\n" (charged / 100.0)
  return $ T.concat [header, body, summaryLine, footer]

-- Payment processing: charges based on PDF generation state
processPayment :: FeatureFlags -> Invoice -> IO (Double, Double)
processPayment ff inv = do
  _pdfContent <- generatePdfInvoice ff inv
  let chargedToCustomer = calcInvoiceTotal ff inv
      displayedToCustomer = sum $ map (calcLineTotalForRender ff inv) (invItems inv)
  return (chargedToCustomer, displayedToCustomer)

-- Example: demonstrates consistent calculation
exampleRun :: IO ()
exampleRun = do
  let flags = FeatureFlags True True False 2
      -- Tax exempt flag on invoice but feature flag OFF
      inv = Invoice "cust-001"
        [ LineItem "Widget" 150 1000.0 0.20  -- $10 each, 150 units, 20% tax
        , LineItem "Gadget" 50 2000.0 0.15   -- $20 each, 50 units, 15% tax
        ] 0.10 True  -- 10% discount, tax exempt
  (charged, displayed) <- processPayment flags inv
  putStrLn $ "Charged: $" ++ show (charged / 100.0)
  putStrLn $ "Displayed: $" ++ show (displayed / 100.0)
  putStrLn $ "Discrepancy: $" ++ show ((charged - displayed) / 100.0)
